name: Carousel
description: A spring-driven slide carousel with drag/swipe, previous/next arrows and pill dots whose active pill fills as the autoplay timer runs. Autoplay pauses on hover, focus and drag, can be stopped with a play/pause button, and optionally loops.
a11yNotes: Follows the WAI-ARIA carousel pattern: a <section> with aria-roledescription="carousel" and an aria-label; each slide is role="group" with aria-roledescription="slide" and an "n of total" label, and inactive slides are aria-hidden. The slide container is a live region (aria-live="off" while auto-rotating, "polite" otherwise). Autoplay pauses whenever the pointer hovers or keyboard focus is inside, and a labelled play/pause button stops rotation entirely. Arrow buttons and dot buttons (aria-current on the active one) are labelled and controls the track; Left/Right arrow keys inside the carousel change slides. Focus is shown with a 2px outline. Under prefers-reduced-motion slides change instantly and autoplay is disabled.

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.type: CarouselItem[]  // { title: string; description?: string; eyebrow?: string; background?: string }
propsApi.description: Slides to render; background accepts any CSS background value (color, gradient or url()).

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Accessible name of the carousel region.

propsApi.name: onValueChange
propsApi.description: Called with the new slide index.

propsApi.name: autoplay
propsApi.description: Advance automatically; pauses on hover, focus and drag, and renders a play/pause button.

propsApi.name: loop
propsApi.description: Wrap from the last slide to the first and back; when false the arrows hide at the ends.

propsApi.name: showDots
propsApi.description: Show the dot pagination with autoplay progress.

propsApi.name: draggable
propsApi.description: Allow drag/swipe navigation (distance or flick velocity).

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Active dot and progress fill color.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
